evals.prompt: Audit the code-scans skill in this repo — is it still accurate against the current tree and AGENTS.md? Fix what's stale.
evals.expected_output: Run in a clone of anomalyco/opencode with the generated code-scans skill committed at 2026-08-20 and the repo advanced to its 2026-09-17 head.
expectations: The pass located .agents/skills/code-scans-<project>/SKILL.md as the target and did not create a new skill
A path audit ran over every backticked repo path in the skill and its results are reported, with each MISSING path resolved as renamed, gone, or a named false positive
The report states exactly one outcome word: clean, changed, or blocked, with justification
Edits, if any, are confined to the code-scans skill's own directory (no changes to source, tests, docs, AGENTS.md, or other skills)
A bounded live survey of one named domain ran using the skill's own corpus rules, with at least two candidates proven or rejected with evidence
Simplification candidates found during the pass are reported to the user but not committed or implemented

At least one real drift introduced by the four weeks of upstream churn between the skill's commit and HEAD is found and corrected (or the report shows a concrete check of doctrine files, tree roots, tooling, and gates that justifies clean)

If the outcome is changed, the resulting SKILL.md passes check-skill-paths.sh with zero MISSING (or every remaining MISSING is a named non-path false positive) and the commit message names what rotted and why
